questions.question: What was the main goal of Artemis I?
answers: To collect Moon rocks by hand
questions.explanation: Artemis I tested the rocket, spacecraft, and ground systems for future missions.

questions.question: How many astronauts flew on Artemis I?
questions.explanation: Artemis I was an uncrewed test flight, so no astronauts were aboard.

questions.question: Which rocket launched the Orion spacecraft on Artemis I?
questions.explanation: The Space Launch System, or SLS, launched Orion on Artemis I.

questions.question: What does SLS stand for?
questions.explanation: SLS means Space Launch System.

questions.question: What was the name of the spacecraft used in Artemis I?
questions.explanation: Orion is the spacecraft that flew on Artemis I.

questions.question: What was the job of the SLS rocket?
questions.explanation: SLS launched Orion and helped send it toward the Moon.

questions.question: What does EGS stand for in the Artemis program?
questions.explanation: EGS means Exploration Ground Systems.

questions.question: What do Exploration Ground Systems help NASA do?
questions.explanation: Ground systems help assemble, launch, and recover rockets and spacecraft.

questions.question: What does Orion's heat shield protect it from?
answers: High heat when returning to Earth
questions.explanation: The heat shield protects Orion from very high temperatures as it returns to Earth.

questions.question: Why was Artemis I important for later missions?
answers: It tested equipment before astronauts used it
questions.explanation: Artemis I helped NASA check important systems before crewed Artemis flights.

questions.question: Which Artemis mission first carried astronauts?
questions.explanation: Artemis II was the first crewed mission in the Artemis program.

questions.question: How many astronauts were on Artemis II?
questions.explanation: Artemis II carried four astronauts.

questions.question: Who was the commander of Artemis II?
questions.explanation: Reid Wiseman was the Artemis II commander.

questions.question: Who was the pilot of Artemis II?
questions.explanation: Victor Glover was the Artemis II pilot.

questions.question: Which two astronauts were mission specialists on Artemis II?
questions.explanation: Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen were the Artemis II mission specialists.

questions.question: About how long was the Artemis II journey?
questions.explanation: Artemis II traveled around the Moon and returned in about ten days.

questions.question: Where did Artemis II travel?
questions.explanation: The Artemis II crew flew around the Moon and came back to Earth.

questions.question: Which Orion system was tested with astronauts on Artemis II?
questions.explanation: Artemis II tested life-support systems that help keep astronauts safe.

questions.question: What does an air-cleaning system help astronauts do?
questions.explanation: Orion has systems that help keep cabin air safe for the crew.

questions.question: What does pressure control help keep safe inside Orion?
questions.explanation: Pressure control helps keep the cabin air pressure safe for astronauts.

questions.question: What does crew waste management handle?
questions.explanation: Crew waste management helps astronauts handle waste during the trip.

questions.question: About how long did Artemis II lose radio contact behind the Moon?
questions.explanation: The Moon blocked radio signals for about 40 minutes.

questions.question: Why did Artemis II lose contact with Earth for a short time?
answers: The astronauts turned off the Sun
The Moon blocked the radio signals
questions.explanation: When Orion passed behind the Moon, the Moon blocked its radio link with Earth.

questions.question: Which Artemis mission is planned to test docking in Earth orbit?
questions.explanation: Artemis III is planned to practice docking Orion with lunar lander test vehicles in low Earth orbit.

questions.question: Who is the commander of Artemis III?
questions.explanation: Randy Bresnik is the commander assigned to Artemis III.

questions.question: Who is the pilot of Artemis III?
questions.explanation: Luca Parmitano is the pilot assigned to Artemis III.

questions.question: Which two astronauts are Artemis III mission specialists?
questions.explanation: Andre Douglas and Frank Rubio are the Artemis III mission specialists.

questions.question: How many astronauts are assigned to Artemis III?
questions.explanation: The Artemis III crew has four astronauts.

questions.question: Where is Artemis III planned to test docking?
questions.explanation: Artemis III is planned to test docking in low Earth orbit.

questions.question: What will Orion practice docking with on Artemis III?
questions.explanation: Orion will practice meeting and docking with commercial lunar lander test vehicles.

questions.question: What does HLS stand for?
questions.explanation: HLS means Human Landing System.

questions.question: What will a Human Landing System do on future Moon missions?
answers: Take astronauts to the Moon's surface
questions.explanation: A Human Landing System is designed to carry astronauts to the lunar surface.

questions.question: How many separate launches are planned for Artemis III?
questions.explanation: The Artemis III mission plan includes three launches.

questions.question: Which Orion systems will Artemis III also test?
questions.explanation: Artemis III is planned to test systems for moving and communicating in space.
